## Description

Provides a TS version of https://github.com/jiboV2/jibohub-client
Used for integration tests and CLI tools.

## CLIENT_ASR session example:


```
const ROBOT_ID = '420';
const ACCOUNT_ID = 'foo';

let options = {
    path: '/v1/listen',
    hostname: 'dev-hub.jibo.com',
    port: "443",
    auth: {
        secret: "some-secret-to-encode-auth",
        credentials: {
            id: ACCOUNT_ID,
            accessKeyId: 'accountAccessKeyID',
            secretAccessKey: 'accountAccessKey',
            friendlyId: ROBOT_ID
        },
};

const listenRequest = {
    hotphrase: true,
    rules: ['launch'],
    mode: interfaces.hub.request.ListenMessageMode.CLIENT_ASR,
    lang: 'en-US'
};

const session = await hubClient.Client.startListenSession(options, listenRequest);

session.events.on('SOS', () => console.log(`Got start of speech`));
session.events.on('EOS', () => console.log(`Got end of speech`));
session.events.on('LISTEN', data => console.log(`Got listen result: `, JSON.stringify(data, null, 4)));
session.events.on('SKILL_ACTION', data => console.log(`Got skill action: `, JSON.stringify(data, null, 4)));

// Here we write a fake context object
session.writeContext(createFakeContextData());

// Now we write the fake ASR results
session.writeClientASR("do you like dogs");

// And wait for the result of the session
await session.transactionDone;
console.log(`Transaction done`);

```
